mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This effect is consistent across monetary regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show no positive correlation with FEDFUNDS level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and fall in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening monetary policy amid labor market strength, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p-value > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST above 1650 thousand units and rising), housing market strength signals overvaluation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1650 and is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns show no positive correlation with PAYEMS growth (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 260 indicates persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening that depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with falling housing starts (HOUST) signals a supply-driven economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises > 0.5pp and HOUST falls > 50 thousand units in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant (p-value > 0.05) in a 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 108.5 signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO falls below 108.5.
